assets.KAIF.md: thin entry point (bootstrap + embedded loader); transient in the target project
assets.KAIF-CORE-BUNDLE.md: the COMPLETE deployable set (docs + skills + spheres + optional tool modules + language packs) as FILE: blocks
assets.kaif-manifest.json: this file — version, codename, sha256 pins, asset roles
assets.KAIF-FULL.md: offline fallback core — a SUBSET (no language packs/spheres/references); not an authoritative diff baseline (last-resort synthetic-baseline candidate only)
assets.kaif-module-map.json: the generated module inventory (signature anchors, classes, sha) — informative: the machinery splits modules itself, so it is neither fetched nor pinned
